not_this: Not validation or qualification of the model; no acceptance limits are introduced.
Not a comparison of individual concentrations; only Ogawa Table 3 means and SDs are used.
Not a re-fit: no parameter is estimated or tuned.
Not a dosing or exposure prediction for any patient.
known_differences: Typical-value (median-like) model compared with arithmetic means of skewed quantities.
Very large between-patient variability on V2 (304% CV) and V3 (114% CV); a typical-value curve may describe few individual patients.
Ogawa n = 7 (day 1) and 5 (day 11) at 1.3 mg/m2; small groups, not the same patients for every value.
Japanese patients may differ from the Kuan population in body size and other covariates; BSA is assumed.
Source is a conference poster; the equation form and units are not fully specified.
